title: Anthropic introduces Claude Opus 5 at half the price of Fable 5
friendlyTitle: Claude Opus 5 aims to bring strong AI work at a lower price
summary: Anthropic has released Claude Opus 5, positioning it as a more efficient model for long-running agents, coding and professional work. The company says it approaches Claude Fable 5 capability at half the token price and has made it the default model on Claude Max.
friendlySummary: Anthropic has released Claude Opus 5 for coding, office work and AI agents. It says the model is close to its more powerful Fable 5 model but costs half as much per token.
whyItMatters: For teams using capable models every day, price and reliability can matter more than winning one benchmark. Opus 5 could make longer coding and knowledge-work sessions economical, although Anthropic’s performance claims still need independent testing.
friendlyWhyItMatters: This may make long AI tasks cheaper for people and businesses. Independent tests will still be useful before changing an important workflow.
